harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: after borg-zoo#198 found a Ranger buying 120 Arrows one transaction at a time, the owner had borg-reborn-rs#507 fixed (PR #509) and asked for a zoo pilot of the fix against main.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read. Pilot (RULES 14); more starts only after this gate and the
owner. Two builds, one profile (the shipped harness/borg.txt, no plan, no errand), on classes-18 and the
10 Ranger starts of classes-1800-small: 56 games. Gate: no config_error; one binary per specimen; no plan
loaded; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; death bundles reproduced. Endpoints, per
specimen: (1) the largest keys at one game turn per game and the number of games with 1,000+ (the fix
counts as working when the candidate has none and its per-game maximum is lower than the control's
on the same start); (2) purchases ("You bought") per game, and how many buy several copies; (3) ammunition
bought (Arrows, Bolts, Shots, Pebbles, Iron Shots), in transactions and in copies, and gold on it
against all gold spent; (4) deaths, final level, deepest level, paired rescued and newly killed against
the control on the same start; (5) any "You do not have enough gold" or "You cannot carry that many
items" message (expected none). Local check on three Ranger starts: the per-turn maximum fell from
149-330 keys to 72-80 and arrow purchases from 87-237 transactions to 14, while copies bought rose
from 87-237 to 276-302; whether buying more ammunition helps or costs gold elsewhere is the open
question. 28 starts per build show direction only.
